calib.title: Calibrate printer
calib.noPrinter: No printer connected. Please connect to print the test pattern and to save.
calib.experimental: The {model} has not been tested yet and starts without corrections: calibrate it here once.
calib.currentLabel: Current: offset across {offset} dots, print start {start} dots, feed factor {scale}.
calib.currentTape: Current: correction for {width} mm tape {value} dots.
calib.intro: Calibration compensates for where your printer actually prints. It is stored for this printer model in this browser and used for every print.
calib.labelInfo: Labels: the length and the position across are calibrated. Continuous paper is not suitable because it has no fixed label edge.
calib.tapeInfo: Tape: the centering across the tape is calibrated for the selected tape width.
calib.consumesTape: Uses about {length} mm of tape ({width} mm).
calib.patternIntro: The test pattern shows a frame around the printable area, a large square top left, a small one bottom left and numbered ticks every 10 mm, measured from the left label edge.
calib.alreadyPrinted: I have already printed the test pattern with the current calibration.
calib.readyToMeasure: Ready to measure. Let the printout cool down for a moment and lay it flat.
calib.fieldA: Left label edge to the left frame line
calib.fieldB: Left label edge to the center of
calib.fieldC: Bottom label edge to the bottom frame line
calib.fieldD: Top tape edge to the top frame line
calib.fieldE: Bottom tape edge to the bottom frame line
calib.measureLabelIntro: Hold the label so that the large square is top left. Measure with a ruler in millimeters, to 0.5 mm if possible.
calib.ruleEdgeStrong: Always measure from the label edge
calib.ruleLines: To a frame line: up to its outer edge. To a tick: up to the middle of the tick. The number above a tick is its target distance in mm.
calib.labelMeasureNote: A and B calibrate the length (only together), C the position across. An empty field leaves its value unchanged.
calib.measureTapeIntro: Hold the tape so that the large square is top left. Measure across the tape from the tape edge to the outer edge of the frame line.
calib.tapeMeasureNote: The correction only applies to {width} mm tape. If the pattern is too small to measure, use a magnifier rather than guessing.
calib.abTogether: Please fill in A and B together (or leave both empty).
calib.atLeast: Please fill in at least A and B, or C.
calib.bothGaps: Please enter both distances D and E.
calib.alreadyCorrect: The print is already in the right place, there is nothing to correct.
calib.savedFor: Saved for {key}. Every print uses it from now on.
calib.verifyHint: To check, print another test pattern and measure again. The values should now be close to the target.
calib.partial: Only the measurements without errors are applied. Or go back and measure again.
calib.confirmReset: Delete the stored calibration for this device and use the default values?
calib.resetDone: Calibration reset, the default values apply.
calib.diagramLabelAria: Sketch: measurements A, B and C on the label
calib.diagramLabelCaption: Left edge = start of the label (comes out of the printer first)
calib.diagramTapeAria: Sketch: measurements D and E on the tape
calib.diagramTapeCaption: Measure D and E across the tape. Equal = centered.

issue.feedOnlyLabels: The feed calibration only applies to labels.
issue.feedNotNumbers: Please enter both length measurements as numbers in mm.
issue.frameImplausible: Distance to the left frame line: {measured} mm is implausible (expected about {expected} mm).
issue.tickBeforeFrame: The tick must be farther from the left label edge than the frame line.
issue.tickBeyondLength: The tick cannot be farther away than the label length ({length} mm).
issue.tickTooClose: Please choose a tick at least 20 mm to the right of the frame line.
issue.feedScaleImplausible: The measurement gives a feed error of {pct}%. That is implausible, please measure again (right tick? Measured from the left label edge?).
issue.feedStartImplausible: The measurement gives a print start at {start} mm. That is implausible, please measure again.
issue.acrossOnlyLabels: This measurement only applies to labels.
issue.acrossNotNumber: Please enter the distance to the bottom frame line as a number in mm.
issue.bottomImplausible: Distance to the bottom frame line: {measured} mm is implausible (expected about {expected} mm).
issue.frameOff: The frame is off by {diff} mm. That is more than plausible, please measure again (bottom edge? Large square top left?).
issue.offsetOutOfRange: The calculated offset is outside the allowed range. Please measure again.
issue.tapeOnlyTape: This measurement only applies to tape.
issue.tapeNotNumbers: Please enter both distances as numbers in mm.
issue.gapTooLarge: A distance is larger than the tape width ({width} mm).
issue.gapSumOff: Both distances add up to {sum} mm, about {expected} mm are expected (tape width minus frame height). Please measure again.
issue.correctionOutOfRange: The calculated correction is outside the allowed range. Please measure again.
issue.noMeasurement: Please enter at least one measurement.
issue.noTick: This label has no numbered tick “{tick}”.

diag.title: Printer profile / diagnostics
diag.intro: This information helps to support more printer models. The serial number is not collected. Nothing is sent automatically: you download the report or open a prefilled GitHub issue (GitHub account needed) and submit it yourself.
diag.notePlaceholder: What works, what does not? Printer model from the rating plate, operating system, loaded media ...
diag.experimental: {model}: experimental, not tested yet. Feedback helps a lot.
diag.unknownModel: Unknown model, printing is disabled. Please send this report.
diag.noDevice: No printer connected. Please click “Connect” first, then open this view again.
diag.tooLong: The report is too long for the link. The JSON file has been downloaded: please attach it to the GitHub form by drag and drop.
